newsitem.title: USA: ECC INTERNATIONAL SAYS WINS $42 MLN CONTRACT.
newsitem.headline: ECC INTERNATIONAL SAYS WINS $42 MLN CONTRACT.

text.p: ECC International Corp said Friday it has been awarded a $42.5 million subcontract to help build Javelin Missile simulators.
The multi-year contract was awarded by the joint venture of Lockheed Martin and Raytheon TI Systems, ECC said in a statement.
The company said the Javelin Missile is the U.S. Army's new fire-and-forget light weight anti-tank missile.
ECC said it has been building the Javelin classrooms and field tactical simulators several years and is currently manufacturing these units under its third low rate initial production contract.
ECC also makes frozen foods and new beverage vending machines.
